---
title: "Graph Structures Lab"
subtitle: "An interactive tour of graphs and the ways we represent them"
---

Every page in this site is built on the same graph engine and the same
canvas. What changes is the second view sitting next to it -- so you can
see one structure re-expressed as a list, a matrix, or a neighbour set.

- **[Sandbox](sandbox.qmd)** -- a blank canvas with the full toolbar: add
  and delete nodes and edges, update labels, and select things to see them
  highlighted.
- **[Adjacency List](adjacency-list.qmd)** -- watch a graph turn into rows
  of `[key]: [neighbour] [neighbour]` boxes, starting with a single row
  before seeing the whole list.
- **[Adjacency Matrix](adjacency-matrix.qmd)** -- the same graph as a grid
  of 0s and 1s, again starting with a single row before the full N x N
  matrix.
- **[Neighbours](neighbours.qmd)** -- click a node to see exactly who it's
  connected to.
